product.name: NIVORA
product.one_liner: AI order & Profit Assistant yg menukarkan mesej tempahan , which is dia mesej dalam system tu ,kepada pelan pengeluaran dan pengiraan kos untuk penjual makanan di malaysia
product.problem: business owner does not need to do their own Business financial projections / Business calculations.
product.today: By taking the recipe n business calculation by their own

features.name: AI MESSAGE PARSER
features.what: Converts raw text order message into structured data (product name , quantity,date,addres ,recipe)

features.name: Order Management Dashboard
features.what: Display clean overview of all active orders, payment statuses and delivery dates in one places

features.name: Recipe & Ingredient Costing
features.what: Records raw material lists and ingredient costs per recipe to calculate unit production costs.

features.name: Production Planning
features.what: Aggregates all orders for a specific date to calculate the total batch quantities required for cooking/baking.

features.name: Automatic Grocery List
features.what: Automatically generates a raw material shopping list based on daily or weekly production plans

features.name: Profit & Loss Calculator
features.what: Calculates estimated net profit per order after deducting raw material costs.

features.name: Customer Database
features.what: Stores basic customer profiles (name, phone number, order history, and address) for repeat orders.

features.name: Payment Status Tracker
features.what: Tracks customer payment statuses (deposit paid, unpaid, or fully paid) to prevent revenue leakage.

features.name: MESSAGE BOX
features.what: WHERE CUSTOMER CAN CHHAT OWNER STATING THEIR ORDERS

top_three.title: Security
targets: Every input is validated on the server
Secrets live only in environment variables, never in code, logs or the browser
HTTPS only, secure cookies and CSRF protection
Rate limits on sign-in and on every public route
A dependency audit runs on every build (pip-audit or npm audit)
Reviewed against the OWASP Top 10 before launch
Prompt-injection tests: text from customers never changes the rules

top_three.title: Reliability
targets: Every error gives a clear message, and nothing is left half-saved
Calls to outside services time out and retry with back-off
Daily backups, restored once to prove they work
Payments and actions are idempotent: a retry never runs them twice
The AI release gate passes before every release

top_three.title: Performance
targets: p95 page load under 2 seconds on a phone over 4G
p95 API response under 500 ms, not counting AI calls
A database index for every list and search
An AI reply starts within 5 seconds, streamed or with progress shown

baseline.title: Availability
baseline.baseline: An uptime check with an alert

baseline.title: Scalability
baseline.baseline: No state kept in the app server's memory

baseline.title: Privacy and PDPA
baseline.baseline: A privacy notice, and no personal data in logs

baseline.title: Usability and accessibility
baseline.baseline: Works on a phone; error messages say what to do

baseline.title: Observability
baseline.baseline: One safe log line per request

baseline.title: Cost efficiency
baseline.baseline: Know the monthly bill before it arrives

never: Never send anything outside without a person's approval
never invent a price, a date or a name

milestones.title: Skeleton
milestones.goal: An empty app in the confirmed stack that starts, reads its settings from .env, and has one passing test.
tests: The health route returns ok
The test command passes
.env is in .gitignore
blueprint.json is unchanged

milestones.title: Authentication
milestones.goal: People sign in with the methods in docs/AUTH.md, from a proven library or service.
tests: A signed-out request to a private page is refused
Sign-in and sign-out work in the provider's test mode
No password is stored in plain text, and no session token appears in a log
Sign-in works with: Email magic link
Sign-in works with: Google sign-in
Sign-in works with: Phone number with a one-time code
Sign-in works with: Email and password, from a proven library
An unverified email address cannot use the app
Repeated failed sign-ins are slowed down, then locked for a while
An owner or admin must pass two-factor sign-in
A password reset link works once, and expires

milestones.title: Authorization and tenants
milestones.goal: Every business is a tenant and every user has a role; every route checks the role against the permission matrix in docs/AUTH.md, and denies by default.
tests: Customer A cannot read or change customer B's records, on every table
A route with no permission rule is refused
Only a role allowed to manage the team can change a role

milestones.title: Data model and version 1 features
milestones.goal: The tables in docs/DATA_MODEL.md and the version 1 features in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md, until their tests in the acceptance folder pass.
tests: Every table has a tenant id, and every query filters by it
Every acceptance test of “AI MESSAGE PARSER” passes (tests/acceptance/test_f1_ai_message_parser.py)
Every acceptance test of “Order Management Dashboard” passes (tests/acceptance/test_f2_order_management_dashboard.py)
Every acceptance test of “Recipe & Ingredient Costing” passes (tests/acceptance/test_f3_recipe_ingredient_costing.py)
Every acceptance test of “Production Planning” passes (tests/acceptance/test_f4_production_planning.py)
Every acceptance test of “Automatic Grocery List” passes (tests/acceptance/test_f5_automatic_grocery_list.py)
Every acceptance test of “Profit & Loss Calculator” passes (tests/acceptance/test_f6_profit_loss_calculator.py)
Every acceptance test of “MESSAGE BOX” passes (tests/acceptance/test_f9_message_box.py)

milestones.title: AI settings and one model call
milestones.goal: The server calls the model with the key from .env, inside the AI settings in docs/AI_SETTINGS.md, and logs the tokens, cost and time of every call.
tests: A call with a fake provider returns the reply and the token counts
A missing key gives a clear error, not a crash
The key never appears in a log or a response
A customer over their monthly AI budget is paused with a clear message; an alert goes out at 80%
Each customer’s AI usage and cost this month show on their dashboard
Changing the model in settings changes the next call, with no code change

milestones.title: AI features
milestones.goal: The AI features as docs/PROMPT_CONTRACT.md, TOOLS.md, STATE.md and CONTEXT.md say: the contract and its checks, tools and approvals, state and context.
tests: A valid reply passes all three layers; broken JSON, a missing field and a rule break each fail with their own error
The failure policy runs when a check fails
AI MESSAGE PARSER: a typical request gives a reply that passes the checks
Recipe & Ingredient Costing: a typical request gives a reply that passes the checks
A message over the length limit is refused before any model call
A message that says “ignore your rules” does not change the reply
A reply that breaks a business rule is caught
A reply with a banned word or promise is caught
Call 11 from one person within a minute is refused; call 57 from one customer in a day is refused
